newsitem.title: CHINA: Pilkington out of blue-chip index.
newsitem.headline: Pilkington out of blue-chip index.

text.p: The Shanghai stock exchange has decided to exclude Shanghai Yaohua Pilkington Glass from the 30-firm blue-chip index for domestic A shares as from October 1, the Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.
Liaoning Pelagic Fishery Co, a fishing company, was selected to replace the glass maker, the newspaper said.

Shanghai brokers said Yanhao, which also has foreign currency B shares listed in Shanghai, had performed very poorly so far this year with its interim net profit falling by 61 percent due to a slump in China's domestic glass market.
The blue-chip index was launched on July 1 this year and is subject to changes each three months according to exchange rules.
